info.title: JSON Minify
info.description: A command-line utility to help developers minify JSON files by removing whitespace and formatting, reducing file size (typically 30%) for production use.

commands.name: file
commands.description: Default command that minifies the specified json file

options.name: --target-folder
options.description:
The target folder where the minified file will be
written. Defaults to the current folder

arguments.name: FILEPATH
arguments.description:
The fully qualified file path for the target json file to
minify

commands.name: folder
commands.description: Command that minifies all of the json files in the specified folder

options.name: --target-folder
options.description:
The target folder where the minified files will be
written. Defaults to the current folder

arguments.name: FOLDERPATH
arguments.description:
The fully qualified target directory/folder path to search
for json files to minify

options.name: --target-folder
options.description:
The target folder where the minified file will be
written. Defaults to the current folder

arguments.name: FILEPATH
arguments.description:
The fully qualified file path for the target json file to
minify
